title: Reef subjects.json
description: The subject vocabulary as a tree, with every assignment and every document title, as published by Reef's precomputer to subjects.json. This describes the precomputed file, which is not the shape of the /api/reef/subjects/ endpoint: the endpoint returns a list and carries no document metadata.

documents.description: Every document any subject is assigned to, once, keyed by canonical identifier. Referenced by identifier from the subject entries rather than repeated beside each subject that covers it.

subjects.description: The vocabulary, keyed by slug, in tree order.

documentIdentifier.description: A canonical Reef document identifier: the series followed by the number, with no separator.

documentMetadata.description: What Reef publishes about a document, resolved from Red's index. Null title means the identifier did not resolve, which is told apart from not having been looked up by the key being present at all.

id.description: The primary key. What a subscription points at, so that renaming a subject does not detach its subscribers.

parent.description: The slug of the subject this one sits under, or null for a top-level subject.

path.description: Slugs from the top down, separated by a slash, ending in this subject's own. The ancestors of a subject are the prefixes of its path.

children.description: The slugs of the live subjects immediately beneath this one.

documents.description: The documents assigned to this subject itself, not to those beneath it. The subtree is derived from path and children.

document_count.description: The length of documents, carried so a picker need not count.

document_count_deep.description: The documents this subject covers, itself and everything beneath it, deduplicated.
